mapper.sql: select inventory.id as inventory_id, inventory.sku_id, inventory.warehouse_id, inventory.zone_id, inventory.location_id, inventory.quantity, sku.sku_name, sku.sku_code, sku.safety_stock, sku.max_stock, item.id as item_id, item.item_name, item.item_code, item.unit, w.warehouse_name, z.zone_name, l.location_code from wms_inventory inventory inner join wms_item_sku sku on inventory.sku_id=sku.id inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id=item.id left join wms_warehouse w on inventory.warehouse_id=w.id left join wms_zone z on inventory.zone_id=z.id left join wms_location l on inventory.location_id=l.id
